issues.description: Method parameter mismatch for Client.assembleBookstore(): The problem description and the template expect a no-argument factory method named `assembleBookstore()` that returns a `Bookstore`. The template includes a commented stub for `assembleBookstore()` with no parameters. In the solution implementation, the method is declared as `private static func assembleBookstore(check: Bool) -> Bookstore` (has one Bool parameter) while `Client.main()` calls `assembleBookstore()` with no arguments. This discrepancy will cause a compilation error at the call site and will confuse students about the intended signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the `assembleBookstore` function signature match the problem statement and template by removing the extra parameter. Change the solution declaration to: `private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore { ... }` so that `Client.main()` can call `assembleBookstore()` without arguments. If the extra parameter is required for testing, instead overload or provide a separate helper with a different name and keep the no-argument `assembleBookstore()` for the public example.
